repos.description: ALL IN ONE Hacking Tool For Hackers
repos.summary_zh: HackingTool 是一个集成化网络安全工具集，专为渗透测试与安全研究人员设计。支持185+工具、20个分类，涵盖匿名隐藏、漏洞利用、Web安全、移动安全等场景。具备智能搜索、标签过滤、一键安装与更新功能，兼容Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS，提供现代化CLI交互体验。
repos.summary_en: HackingTool is an all-in-one cybersecurity toolkit for security researchers and pentesters. It integrates 185+ tools across 20 categories including anonymity, exploitation, web, and mobile security. Features include smart search, tag filtering, one-click installation/updates, OS-aware menus, and Docker support, optimized for Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS with a modern CLI interface.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repos.summary_zh: FreeLLMAPI 是一款聚合 16 家主流 AI 厂商免费额度的 OpenAI 兼容代理网关。它通过单一 /v1 端点提供约 1.7 亿 Token/月的算力，具备智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥存储功能，旨在解决多 SDK 调用复杂和额度分散的痛点，适合个人开发者进行低成本 AI 实验。
repos.summary_en: FreeLLMAPI is an OpenAI-compatible proxy aggregating free tiers from 16 major LLM providers into a single /v1 endpoint, delivering ~1.7B tokens/month. It features smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key storage, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple SDKs and scattered quotas for personal AI experimentation.

repos.description: Happy is the open-source desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, with an iOS and Android app to control your coding agents from anywhere.
repos.summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

repos.description: ZeroNet - Decentralized websites using Bitcoin crypto and BitTorrent network
repos.summary_zh: ZeroNet 是一个去中心化网站平台，利用比特币加密和 BitTorrent 网络实现无中心托管。网站内容通过 P2P 网络分发，支持实时更新、Namecoin 域名、Tor 匿名访问及 TLS 加密，无需服务器即可永久运行，抗审查且用户即服务提供者。
repos.summary_en: ZeroNet is a decentralized web platform using Bitcoin cryptography and the BitTorrent network for censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer hosting. Sites run on users' devices, support real-time updates, .bit domains, Tor anonymity, and automatic peer discovery without relying on central servers.

repos.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
repos.summary_zh: 将 ChatGPT 网页版作为 Codex 编码会话的规划与审查大脑，执行权完全保留在 Codex。通过 OAuth 保护的只读 MCP 连接按需读取代码，仓库永不上传，无需 API Key 或逆向代理，充分利用付费订阅额度。
repos.summary_en: Uses the ChatGPT web app as the planning and review brain for Codex coding sessions, while Codex retains full execution control. Secure read-only MCP connection via OAuth reads only needed code; repo is never uploaded. No API key or reverse proxy required.

repos.description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go/React和WebRTC的端到端P2P文件传输工具，支持文件、文字传输及桌面共享，数据直连不经过服务器，具备端到端加密、响应式设计和Docker一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A secure, privacy-focused P2P file transfer tool built with Go/React and WebRTC, enabling direct file, text, and desktop sharing without server relay, featuring end-to-end encryption, responsive design, and Docker deployment.

repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.description: JSON Web Token Authentication support for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为 Django REST Framework 提供 JSON Web Token (JWT) 身份验证支持，实现无状态用户认证。适用于需要安全、可扩展 API 的场景，如前后端分离应用。现已停止维护，建议使用官方或活跃替代方案。
repos.summary_en: This package adds JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication support for Django REST Framework, enabling stateless API security. Ideal for modern web applications requiring secure, scalable authentication. Note: Project is unmaintained; alternatives recommended.

repos.summary_zh: Python Social Auth 是一个简单易用的社交认证/注册机制库，支持多种框架和第三方认证提供商。基于 django-social-auth 重构，提供统一接口定义新认证源，并扩展对更多框架和 ORM 的支持。该项目已于2016年12月3日停止维护，代码已迁移至 python-social-auth 组织。
repos.summary_en: Python Social Auth is a simple social authentication/registration library supporting multiple frameworks and auth providers. Built on django-social-auth, it offers a unified interface to define third-party authentication providers and extend support for additional frameworks and ORMs. Deprecated since Dec 3, 2016, with code migrated to the python-social-auth organization.

repos.summary_zh: Django Social Auth 是一个为 Django 项目提供社交登录功能的库，支持 Google、Facebook、Twitter 等 40+ 主流平台的 OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID 认证。它基于 python-social-auth 构建，提供用户注册、多账号关联、自定义用户模型和认证管道扩展等核心能力，现已被官方标记为弃用状态。
repos.summary_en: Django Social Auth is a deprecated library enabling social login via OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID for Django projects. It supports 40+ providers including Google, Facebook, and Twitter, offering user registration, multi-account association, custom user models, and extensible authentication pipelines. Now superseded by python-social-auth.

repos.description: Authenticator on Windows for Battle.net / Steam / Guild Wars 2 / Glyph / Runescape / SWTOR / Bitcoin and digital currency exchanges
repos.summary_zh: WinAuth 是一款开源的 Windows 多平台双因子认证工具，支持 RFC 6238 时间型（TOTP）和 HOTP 计数器型验证码，兼容 Battle.net、Steam、Guild Wars 2、SWTOR 及主流数字货币交易所。具备密码保护、机器绑定、YubiKey 支持、热键操作、便携模式及跨设备导入导出功能，适用于安全与便捷的双重认证管理。
repos.summary_en: WinAuth is an open-source, portable authenticator for Windows that supports RFC 6238 (TOTP) and HOTP-based 2FA codes. It integrates authenticators for Battle.net, Steam, Guild Wars 2, SWTOR, and major cryptocurrency exchanges like Coinbase and Bitstamp. Features include password protection, machine binding, YubiKey support, hotkey controls, portable mode, and import/export via UriKeyFormat, enabling secure and unified two-factor authentication management.

repos.description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
repos.summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
repos.summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

repos.description: SnackBase is a Python/FastAPI-based BaaS providing auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security, authentication, enterprise OAuth/SAML, and comprehensive admin UI.
repos.summary_zh: SnackBase 是一个基于 Python/FastAPI 的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在作为 Supabase 的自托管替代方案。它提供自动生成的 REST API、多租户架构、行级安全（RLS）、企业级认证（OAuth/SAML）以及功能完备的 React 管理后台，支持 SQLite 与 PostgreSQL，助力开发者快速构建安全的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: SnackBase is an open-source, Python/FastAPI-based Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed as a self-hosted Supabase alternative. It offers auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security (RLS), enterprise authentication (OAuth/SAML), and a comprehensive React admin UI, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL for rapid enterprise application development.

repos.summary_zh: 腾讯云优图人脸服务Python SDK，提供人脸检测、比对、识别、验证及人脸库管理功能，支持本地图片与URL输入，集成API签名鉴权，适用于身份认证、安防监控等场景。
repos.summary_en: Tencent YouTu Face Service Python SDK enables face detection, comparison, recognition, and verification, with support for local images and URLs. It includes API authentication and person/group management, ideal for identity verification and security applications.
